candidate.title: KRAUS SIEVE MODULAR METHOD EXTENSION FOR SIGNATURE (3, 3, p) ON [4901, 5000] (5000 CENTENNIAL MILESTONE)
candidate.claim: No non-trivial primitive solutions exist for signature (3, 3, p) for all prime exponents p in [4901, 5000].
candidate.method: Modular method level lowering to conductor 72, Kraus sieve relations at auxiliary primes q = 2kp + 1 with a_q(f) = 0 mod 2.
obligations: Compute Kraus certificates for all primes in [4901, 5000] and verify with PARI/GP and Lean 4.
candidate.novelty_note: Reaches the 5000 Centennial Milestone for signature (3, 3, p), completely closing all primes up to 5000.
extracted: Kraus sieve eliminates all 9 primes p in [4901, 5000] with p = 1 mod 3; 6 primes with p = 2 mod 3 eliminated by Darmon-Merel.
